author: diegorZ4579VF

title: A lovely night thanks to our tour guide
text: We had a memorable evening thanks to our guide, Rocío. Not only was she an outstanding guide and shared a wealth of information but she tailored the tour to our needs and to us. I thought going to the Mirador would be impossible for me but she got us there. She even helped us find a great Moroccan restaurant to top off the evening. In summary, the views were awesome, the guide outstanding and the tour was absolutely worth it.
author: MariaC_R

title: Great tour
text: Very good tour. Interesting and informative. The tour is ideal to take before seeing the Alhambra as it fills in a lot of historical knowledge about the city origins. Our guide Lorena was amazing. I recommend this tour.
author: Gavmeisteruk1

title: Amazing guide to an absolutely fantastic destination
text: We had a fabulous tour with our guide Gabriela She was so knowledgeable about all things Alhambra with a great presentation style as well as being very personable. She was able to answer all our questions and guided us around in a lovely relaxed way. We started the tour at 8:30 which was definitely worth doing to make the most of the cooler morning.
author: GrandTour25921340385

title: walking tour of The Albaizin, ancient muslim neighborhood in Granada
text: Our guide Alberto was superb, fluent in both English & Spanish, very well-versed in the history of the Albaizin, also very accommodating for our need for rest stops d/t all the climbing up steps (we're both over 60 yo ! )   Alberto & this guide service are highly recommended
author: ricardoo723

title: Telling the Stories of the Albaicín
text:
We did a private walking tour with Jenny and it was an exceptional experience! 
Very informative, and at the same time focusing on the human side of the many important events and historic sites that make Granada one of the focus points of European and even world history. Jenny’s broad knowledge of adjacent topics that illustrated the mere historical facts and gave so much context made us love every minute of this tour! 
Highly recommended!
author: Daniel M

title: Free walking tour turns out to be a priceless memory
text: It was my first free walking tour and I couldn’t have wished for a better experience. Marta was very openhearted and energetic, super educated and inspired me a lot with what she told us about the history of Granada. I enjoyed to get to know the neighbourhoods of Albaicín and Sacromonte with her and the nice group members from all over the world. 10/10 experience!
author: 40franziskak
